text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho over, public 
attention shifted from a "Big Two" to the 
fierce "Big Three" clash of BNW!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and—Winning 
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To win the stage of her dreams, the Japan 
Derby, Winning Ticket asks Narita Taishin 
for a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Competing against a rival who charges 
toward her dreams has had a positive 
influence on Narita Taishin. —Or so it was 
supposed to be.
